notablePrerequisites: You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Culling the Weak for its escape cost by paying {B}, exling three other cards from your graveyard, and sacrificing Stiticher's Supplier.
Stitcher's Supplier dies, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve Culling the Weak, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Stitcher's Supplier for its escape cost by paying {B} and exling three other cards from your graveyard.
Stitcher's Supplier enters the battlefield, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing another creature, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Pinnacle Monk and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Pinnacle Monk tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing Archaeomancer, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Persist by paying {1}{B}, returning Archaeomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Inalla.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Archaeomancer with haste.
The token Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Persist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Archaeomancer tokens, if Inalla is on the battlefield, you may activate Inalla's ability infinite times to cause infinite lifeloss for opponents.

notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 13 life.
description:
Cast Spellseeker, stacking Inalla's trigger under Spellseeker's ETB trigger.
Tutor Culling the Weak to hand with Spellseeker's ability.
Cast Culling the Weak, sacrificing Spellseeker and adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve and pay for the Inalla trigger from earlier, creating a token copy of Spellseeker and leaving {B}{B}{B} floating.
When the token ETBs, tutor Unearth to your hand.
Unearth Spellseeker, leaving {B}{B} floating.
Shortcut resolving both Inalla's trigger and Spellseeker's ETB, tutoring for Burnt Offering and Finale of Promise, leaving {B} floating.
Cast Burnt Offering, sacrificing Spellseeker and adding {B}{R}{R}.
Use that mana to cast Finale of Promise with X=1 targeting Unearth and Culling the Weak.
Sacrifice a Spellseeker token to Culling the Weak for {B}{B}{B}{B} and Unearth Spellseeker.
Resolve Spellseeker's ETB and Inalla's trigger, tutoring Entomb and Reanimate into hand.
Entomb and then Reanimate Archaeomancer, leaving {B} floating.
Resolve Archaeomancer's ETB, returning Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Burnt Offering on Archaeomancer, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger from when Archaeomancer ETB'd and return Reanimate to your hand, leaving {B}{B}{B} floating.
Reanimate Archaeomancer and resolve the Inalla trigger, retrieving Burnt Offering and FInale of promise, {B} floating.
Sacrifice Archaeomancer to Burnt Offering, adding {R}{R}{B}{B}.
Cast FInale of Promise with X=1 targeting Entomb and Reanimate.
Entomb Shallow Grave and Reanimate Archaeomancer, {B} floating.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger returning Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Sacrifice Archaeomancer to Burnt Offering, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, making a token copy of Archaeomancer with haste and leaving {B}{B}{B} floating.
Return Shallow Grave with the token copy's ETB.
Cast Shallow Grave targeting Archaeomancer, leaving {B} floating.
Repeat steps 20-24 for infinite hasty Archaeomancers.

feature.name: Return all instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand

description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Corpse Dance by paying {2}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Culling the Weak and Corpse Dance to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

feature.name: Return all instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand

notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nontoken creature.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B}, causing you to sacrifice a creature and return Scholar of the Ages and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Culling the Weak and Victimize to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Culling the Weak, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Greenwarden of Murasa token, adding {1}.
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa for its evoke cost by paying {4}.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, repeat steps 1 through 5 once.
Resolve the evoke trigger from step 7, doing nothing.
Repeat from step 6.

feature.name: Return all instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand
Put all instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard and library into your hand

description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Auton Soldier and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Auton Soldier dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Auton Soldier tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Culling the Weak, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
notes: The additional Kairi trigger in step 4 can be used to put all instants and sorceries from your library and graveyard into your hand, or to bounce permanents.

feature.name: Infinite copies of instant and sorcery spells on the stack

notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two lands.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand from the battlefield, copying Culling the Weak.
Resolve the copy of Culling the Weak, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two lands onto the battlefield tapped from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other instant and/or sorcery spell on the stack to get infinite copies of them.
